C0759.title: Ctrip Fined RMB 10 Million, Sounding Another Alarm for Data Export Compliance
C0759.summary: On June 13, 2026, the Shanghai Cyberspace Administration imposed an administrative penalty of RMB 10 million on Shanghai Ctrip Commerce Co., Ltd., citing failures to conduct required data export security assessments and the illegal transfer of personal information overseas.
